notes.title: New server every 2 minutes & Bot Pirates to fill up empty slots!
notes.content:
Hello Pirates!
Today we've got several great news to announce. We've been working hard for the past month to prepare well for the [b]Steam Autumn Sale[/b]! Both the game and servers are ready for much bigger naval battles! 

[h3]No waiting times before the rounds![/h3]
Whenever you hit the [i]Ready [/i]button, you will be sure to start a new journey [b]within 2 minutes or less[/b]. There are enough official servers in every region for any number of pirate crews. 

If you're looking for someone to aim at, there are:
[h3]Up to 99 bots ready to fight on each server![/h3]
Any new server is equipped with 40 bots to start with. If the number of players is bigger than the number of bots - the game will start as full PvP.
We will continue to organize the '[i]Play With Devs[/i]' events and schedule on [url=https://discord.gg/znzQ7gb]Discord[/url] matches on servers filled with up to 99 bots minus the number of Players.
[url=https://discord.gg/znzQ7gb][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34061556/2eb56a77f5b269a0dd2368ad755b2a7f6f326ae9.png[/img][/url]   

[h3]Numerous fixes to improve smooth gameplay![/h3]
We've focused on minimal FPS count this time. After gathering reports from you, we've fixed many areas that didn't run smoothly on low-end rigs.
[list]
[*]Fixed FPS issues when the last island emerges from underwater
[*]Fixed FPS issues when many new ships approach player's ship
[*]Fixed FPS issues when grabbing ship's wheel
[*]Fixed FPS issues when aiming with scopes
[*]Fixed FPS issues when there are too many particles and explosions involved
[*]Fixed synchronization issues when there are more than 40 players on a server and ships don't sail smoothly
[*]Fixed issue that could potentially cause enemy players to be invisible
[*]Improved several texture sizes for a better overall look, including cannons
[/list]  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34061556/94ac572b116be45bd9c46d0a26b029b12266ae39.png[/img]

notes.title: Changelogs 0.2.1 to 1.0.3-18
notes.content:
[h2]Changelog 1.0.3-18:[/h2]
[h3]Optimization:[/h3]
[list]
[*] LoD system otpimisation (CPU)
[*] optimization related to the using of chests and doors (CPU)
[*] optimization of the game map by getting rid of many unnecessary elements (RAM)
[*] terrains optimization (GPU)
[/list]

[h3]Removing the treasure from the altar:[/h3]
[list]
[*] when the team has not collected 3 treasures yet
[*] has its own top screen event
[*] press 'E' near altar and wait 2s
[/list]

[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] fix for invisible tables when decals are off
[*] update min players to start (for events)
[*] fix for creating broken ammunition via split (in a specific situation)
[*] fix for drop fps in main menu when a player with no avatar appears among friends
[*] crash fix when returning to main menu when friends include a player with no avatar
[*] fix for black screen instead of exiting limbo in rare situations
[*] slider settings: the zoom sensitivity works like the sensitivity of the mouse. Reducing the speed difference between scopes

[/list]

[list]
[*] Fixed floors that could eat weapons on the Aztec island
[*] Fixed walls that could make players stuck
[*] Fixed infinite loading screens in certain situations
[*] Fixed player count in certain situations
[*] Fixed players in weird poses when the are still joining

[*] Fixed chat colors
[*] Fixed drinking and smoking from the FPP view
[*] Fixed joining empty lobbies in certain cases
[*] Fixed reloading animation to match HUD bullet count
[*] Fixed player's dead chest to better snap and sail on ships
[*] Fixed no damage of AOF explosions in certain cases
[*] Fixed no perma damage indicator (lower HP bar) in certain cases

[*] Added popup when player's GPU has no required Shader Model 5.0

[/list]

[*] Added Mouse sensitivity for scopes 1/5x to 5x
[*] Added missing fractured parts to buildings getting destroyed
[*] Added standard viewfinders for each weapon
[*] Added cliffs and big rocks between islands
[*] Added ramps to climb faster from the ocean in harbor areas
[*] Added pirate voices for every command wheel option 
[*] Added random spawn points for the Altar Island
[*] Added the new Krakenhunter island!
[*] Added new version of the ocean, many fixes and improvements
[*] Added new ingame and Steam badges to get along with Steam Achievements
[*] Added Mute voice chat buttons for teammates
[*] Added Failover for not working server list when Steam lags 
[*] Added "Apply changes" pop-up in the main menu and other 'Are you sure' questions
[*] Added secondary anticheat system to the original server based one
[*] Fixed loot in chests around the big pyramid
[*] Fixed Steam avatars in final statistics
[*] Fixed walking and running sounds on different grounds
[*] Fixed matchmaking issues and empty server choosers
[*] Fixed Defaults button in menus
[*] Fixes and tweaks on the Aztec islands
[*] Fixed crashes when exiting the game
[*] Fixed underwater effect glitch when being above the surface
[*] Fixed transparent ship shakes when trying to summon it
[*] Fixed not always working objectives and treasures to find
[*] Fixed disappearing sails
[*] Fixed too high or steep stairs
[*] Fixed building destructions for players who were too far to see it happening
[*] Fixed recoil effects that could interfere with other camera effects such as 'leaving cannons' motion
[*] Fixed skeletons in limbo that got hair and clothes when players changed them in the inventory
[*] Reworked and polished main menu windows for better overall optimization
[*] Optimized cursed ring zone
[*] Optimizations on every island
[*] Better UI layout for 4:3 aspect screens
[*] Better balanced loot spawns on many islands
[*] Better Kraken animations when spawning ships
[*] Better underwater physics, also for dead pirates
[*] Better UI response when receiving damage
[*] Improved archipelago map - all island are visible and zoom got better
[*] Improved grenade aiming
[*] Improved shake effects for jumping and climbing
[*] Improved mouse sensitivity option
[*] Improved ships collisions
[*] Improved zoom-out animations for every type of weapon
[*] Prewarming shaders and objects before the round starts for better FPS
[*] Further optimizations - up to 1GB less RAM usage thanks to better textures and sounds
[*] Lots of CPU optimizations
[*] Additional LOD group fixes 
[*] Smoother character movement
[*] Rearranged 38 loot chests for easier access
[/list]

[h3]Reworked east part of the Castle Island:[/h3]
[list]
[*] new buildings
[*] more loot spawns
[*] better shoreline
[/list]

[h3]Improved Skull Island:[/h3]
[list]
[*] new paths and buildings
[*] more secret spots- more loot
[*] added another, top entrance to the cave
[/list]

[h2]Changelog 0.2.1:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed UI elements that didn't work properly with different languages
[*] Fixed commands wheel that could be opened together with the map or inventory 
[*] Fixed summary screen to properly display stats on different ratio aspects
[*] Fixed wrongly placed obstacles on the Altar island
[*] Added another server synchro for doors, chests and windows when the game starts (fixed permanently closed cages) 
[*] Fixed and added many graphic details on the Aztec Island
[*] Player icons on the main map render above other icons
[*] Press right or middle mouse button to place or delete a waypoint
[*] Added more waypoint icons to the main map 
[*] Fixed changing weapon with a mouse wheel not to instantly attack with a sword 
[*] Added a new version of the commands wheel 
[*] Newly added caves got echo
[*] Fixed loot spawns that could spawn loot under obstacles
[*] Fixed missing avatars on the team summary screen (moved to tests)
[*] Fixed double cursed ring that could spawn in certain situations
[*] Updated engine version to 2019.4.6f1  
[*] Items on the ground moved to clusters to improve frame rates
[*] Waypoints act better when players look at them from a moving ship
[*] Added credits window in the main menu
[*] Fixed app crash when hitting Exit game (moved to tests)
[/list]

notes.title: Play with Devs - everyday
notes.content:
[url=https://discord.gg/znzQ7gb][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34061556/2eb56a77f5b269a0dd2368ad755b2a7f6f326ae9.png[/img][/url]
[h3]Daily event[/h3]
Hi guys, 
since last week, there's a '[b]Play with Devs[/b]' counter in the main menu. We would like to encourage everyone to join the servers and play with or against us [b]every day around 8-10PM GMT[/b]!

Of course, the official servers will stay ready to start another round [u]any time of the day[/u] and we are open to set the second best time to accumulate everybody. Right now the events take place during the usual online peak and will be prolonged until our playerbase is high enough to provide pirate crews willing to fight anytime around the clock.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34061556/94ac572b116be45bd9c46d0a26b029b12266ae39.png[/img]
[h3]Upcoming patch[/h3]
We are also working on a new patch to bring additional features to the game, right now we've got:
[list]
[*]Smoke bombs to provide tactical coverage or just to remind you of good times in CS
[*]Multibolt crossbow - silent and works like a harpoon when used underwater
[*]Explosive barrels - float on water, good to lose the chase
[*]Stationary, 360° Mortar cannons on cliffs and islands
[*]Sword Finishers - eliminate opponents easier and with style 
[/list]
And several features that we still talk about:
[list]
[*]Second smaller ship, better for 2 pirate crews
[*]Hang-glider made of a boat and sails, ready to take off on cliffs and bomb anything below
[/list]

See you on a server today!

notes.title: Treasure Royale is released!
notes.content:
We are happy to announce that OoR: Treasure Royale 1.0 is released! After many months of developing we feel ready to show the game to you and the broaden audience! Nevertheless, we are already working on new features listed below. Don't hesitate to share your opinion on the Steam hub or directly on our Discord!

What's next to come:[list]
[*] tactical grenades such as Smoke Bomb
[*] multibolt crossbow - silent and waterproof
[*] Sword finishers - improved sneaky attacks with higher damage and many animations
[/list]

Planned:[list]
[*] rotary mortars - big cannons placed on most crowded spots on the archipelago, ready to sink any ship
[*] cannon ammo types - f.e. chainlinked balls to destroy sail masts easier
[*] explosive floating barrels
[/list]

Under discussion (let us know what you think):[list]
[*] Another ship to choose, better for Duo teams
[*] Pirate Hang-glider made of a small boat and sails, ready to be launch from cliffs[/list]

[h3]Join our Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/znzQ7gb]https://discord.gg/znzQ7gb[/url][/h3]
Ask us anything or find a crew to sail together

Big thanks to everyone who played during the Steam Festival, reported issues and shared ideas for the upcoming patches! Here's the changelog with the last week fixes:

[h3]Changelog 1.0.3 -6:[/h3]
[list]Fixed:
[*] floors that could eat weapons on the Aztec island
[*] walls that could make players stuck 
[*] infinite loading screens in certain situations
[*] player count in certain situations
[*] players in weird poses when the are still joining- the first objective that can now spawn in a random place max 1km from a crew
[*] chat colors 
[*] drinking and smoking from the FPP view- joining empty lobbies in certain cases- reloading animation to match HUD bullet count
[*] player's dead chest to better snap and sail on ships
[*] no damage of AOF explosions in certain cases

[*] bamboo damaged roofs that could make players stuck
Added popup when player's GPU has no required Shader Model 5.0
Added option to stop using medkit when climbing, fixing ships, using wheel and cannons[/list]

notes.title: Free Week during the Steam Festival!
notes.content:
Hello guys,
today we bring several announcements about the upcoming release of Treasure Royale!

[h3]Stream on Steam festival[/h3]
First things first - another Steam Festival with free demos is scheduled for October and we take part in it! Don't miss the opportunity to check how the game improved since June and what you can expect from the 1.0 version! 

You will be able to join us and play together on one of the servers almost anytime during the week, or simply watch our Stream here on the store or on the official festival page.  

[h3]Celebration of the International Talk Like a Pirate day![/h3]
We couldn't miss that. In Treasure Royale, along with the standard VoiceChat available for everyone, we've added a double Command Wheel for those who are not happy with their pirate voice or just want to mark something quickly and inform every other team pirate.

[previewyoutube=mR4ZTvXaOIE;full][/previewyoutube]

By the way, during the Steam Pirate Sale you can grab the first Out of Reach survival game with a really nice discount ;)

notes.title: Changelog 0.2.0
notes.content:
[h2]Changelog 0.2.0:[/h2]

[h3]Add-ons:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added necessary code to unlock Kickstarter rewards!
[*] The new archipelago of the Lost City 
[*] Reorganized map with different island positions 
[*] The first version of the  (hold Middle Mouse Button to use) 
[*] Team summary screen (when player finished a round together with the other crew members)
[*] Added mute chat command: type /mute or /unmute and then 1,2,3 to choose a player. List is under /listmuted
[*] Additional info why a the player can't put treasures on the altar when they don't have all 3 pieces of them
[*] Added strokes to texts on HUD
[*] Added an option to open skeleton cages in lobby
[*] Added 'Killed in Limbo' stats to player's statistics
[*] Added: weapons can be changed with a mouse wheel
[/list]

[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed shaking crosshair of blunderbuss and similar weapons when sailing
[*] Fixed hovering over a waypoint that didn't show whose pin it was
[*] Fixed Raycast checker - system used to verify collisions when climbing or swinging swords
[*] Fixed running up the stairs that didn't play the animation in certain cases 
[*] Fixed the ship's wheel rotate animation when ship was slowing down
[*] Fixed chat that couldn't display long chat history
[*] Fixed shaking legs and bouncing characters on fast sailing ships
[*] Fixed climbing on obstacles that could make the screen flicker
[*] Fixed player's death chest that couldn't be opened in certain situations
[*] Fixed Summon ship HUD info to show a correct, binded key
[*] Fixed chat to improve responsiveness
[/list]

[h3]Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Ramming stern of the other ship doesn't stop the player's ship and deals damage only when speed difference is high enough
[*] Team eliminated info is now sent to the whole killer team, not just the one who killed the last poor pirate of a crew
[*] Updated Duck foot weapon model for better aiming
[*] Map and inventory work on the Limbo island too
[*] Updated ocean to the newest version including many optimization fixes
[*] Migrated to the newest version of the engine
[*] Crew names stay on screen even when players are behind obstacles
[*] Chests and items sink slower
[/list]

notes.title: Changelog 0.1.5
notes.content:
Changelog 0.1.5:

The new design of the sunken Altar Island!
[list]
[*] Added many details and sculptures
[*] Added another floors, walls, and strategic places to hide inside
[/list]

Fixes:
[list]
[*] Fix for rare case of wrong counting of alive players
[*] Inventory and map can be open when using a cannon
[*] Crossbow add-on cannot be found any more (it will return with the crossbow release)
[*] RMB on an opened map will not trigger aiming
[*] Fix for shooting through ship windows
[*] Fix for a rare case of missing weapons in enemies' death chests
[*] Shooting skeletons that are leaving the Island of the Damned will not increase experience any more
[*] Fix for strange behaviour of swimming character just before the game summary screen
[*] Improved ragdoll for swimming characters
[*] Loot balances - more in deserted places and houses and no loot under the terrain
[*] Curse ring starts shrinking after 15 min instead of 20 min if no one summons the Altar Island
[*] Possibility to bind one key with two actions
[*] Fix for character issues when climbing the ship
[*] Fixed 'Mark enemy' button that could spawn yellow waypoint instead of the red one
[*] Fix for issues when connecting to master server
[*] Anti-cheat system takes into account long range barrels
[*] Weapon add-on that is taken off will not grant bonuses any more
[*] You can look around during climbing
[*] Better swimming experience when diving
[*] Fix for wrong camera rotation when using cannons
[*] Additional force for projectiles when shooting from sailing ships
[*] Friendly Fire disabled
[*] Fix for strange behaviour of a character jumping in front of the ship
[*] Rum works twice longer!
[*] Increased the amount of rum in the bottle and keg (30 -> 40, 60 -> 80 respectively)
[*] Multiclick of med / rum quickslot will not block action by anti-cheat system
[*] Easier grabbing of ammunition from the ground and chests
[*] Switching items doesn't drop them in front of the player
[*] Sound effects turn off with the game summary screen
[*] Item waypoints disappear after a certain amount of time
[*] Player can mark two items at the same time
[*] Updated graphics of the enemy marking
[*] Yellow waypoints are visible when in the archipelago and also Island of the Damned
[*] Updated objectives - changed spawn locations to increase the dynamic of the gameplay and looting possibilities
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34061556/94ac572b116be45bd9c46d0a26b029b12266ae39.png[/img]

[*] Updated objectives - changed spawn locations to increase the dynamic of the gameplay and looting possibilities
[/list]

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/playway/out-of-reach-treasure-royale][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/867400/extras/TreasureRoyale-Kickstarter-supportus2.gif[/img][/url]

Hello guys and welcome back after the Steam Festival and 7 days of constant sailing! First of all we really want to thank you for all your feedback and motivation! 

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/playway/out-of-reach-treasure-royale?ref=steam][h3]Kickstarter[/h3][/url]
This time we are pleased to announce that our [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/playway/out-of-reach-treasure-royale?ref=steam]Kickstarter[/url] campaign has just started! 
Everyone who wants to support [b]Treasure Royale[/b] can also choose one of the prepared perks - starting from small badges and credits mention to assets that will be visible to all the players such as self-made sail banners, ship textures of your design, clothes, rum or even bigger 3D models!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34061556/893737233e2f61918ef924c0cc98f99b1dfbbe57.png[/img]
Just click the link below and find out for yourself!
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/playway/out-of-reach-treasure-royale?ref=steam]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/playway/out-of-reach-treasure-royale[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34061556/3e4632fd9fdf4134149717fd9fcb43207491dc96.png[/img]
[h3]Beta tests[/h3]
What's more, for every Kickstarter backer, we will be hosting beta tests once a week, where you can play a couple of rounds to check how the development goes while we do our deeper testing as usual. Of course, if there's enough pirates on a server, you will be able to keep playing long after the testing is over. :)

[h3]Discord, Feedback and Suggestions[/h3]
We are always pleased to read what you think about features that we keep adding to [b]Treasure Royale[/b]. As Kickstarter backers you will get access to our private Discord channel and get all the attention you desire when talking about the game and what's next to be patched!

[h3]The Next patch[/h3]
As you may imagine, we've collected several tons of feedback during the Festival and work constantly on the new content. Right now we're preparing 2 new big bioms with several islands inside. Map to explore got bigger, guns and drop rates got the necessary polishing, ship and bullet physics is already improved, as well as dozens of small tweaks to make the gameplay even more absorbing. The complete changelog will be posted before the first round of beta tests next week!

Thanks again and see you soon!

notes.title: Out of Reach: Treasure Royale - free demo of the upcoming Pirate Battle Royale!
notes.content:
Hi guys, we're glad that [b]Treasure Royale[/b] draw your attention during the Steam Summer Festival! 
What you can see in the trailer or perhaps even download right now is an effect of our 2 year day-and-night work to create a challenging mix of well known[b] Battle-Royale[/b] and [b]Pirate / Naval-battles[/b] game. 


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/867400/extras/TreasureRoyale-Entrygiff1.gif?t=1591897022[/img]


For the whole duration of the festival, you will be able to[b] experience most of the already implemented features[/b] on a map ready for dozens of players. 
[h3]Core features in a nutshell[/h3]
[list][*] Invite up to 3 friends, go alone or join a random team on one of the official, always-online servers 
[*] Win a battle-royale style round against 25 to 99 other pirates
[*] Find loot, treasures and enemies on a 7sq mi (20km²) ocean with more than a dozen of islands (and more to come!)
[*] Use fully interactive ship to sail, ram, bombard and outstrip your opponents
[*] When eliminated - fight as a skeleton pirate against the others or wait for your crew to perform a revive ritual
[*] When left on a wrecked ship - sacrifice a part of your HP to summon a friendly Kraken to fetch you another one!
[*] Complete objectives and protect your treasure against other crews in the center of the Archipelago to win a round!
[*] Collect experience, unlock unique pirate clothes, customize ships, set up your crew's banner![/list]  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34061556/46869e94651989eab540a007f65882caaf16d966.png[/img]

[h3]Want more?[/h3] 
[h3][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/playway/out-of-reach-treasure-royale]Kickstarter[/url][/h3]
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/playway/out-of-reach-treasure-royale]Click[/url] to follow our upcoming campaign and get notified when it starts off on June 28! 
As a reward for helping us add as many features to the game as possible, you will be rewarded with a long range of gifts from sail banners, hats, ship paints to your own rum brand or your own 3D model implemented to the main map!

notes.title: Dev-blog #2: Ship manual
notes.content:
Hi guys, we are back with new blog posts to clearly describe what Treasure Royale is about after almost 2 years of development. Today we want to summarize all the features and mechanics of pirate ships!

1. Customize
Every crew starts their journey on a pirate ship equipped to destroy other ships and, in the meantime, cross oceans as fast as possible. First things first, the crew captain is given an opportunity to choose a ship skin, sails colors and one of the unlocked banners. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34061556/4967a44ce76c7a8e1cccf3ae7919a89d4dcc3a79.png[/img]
 
Future updates are supposed to bring also additional sail stamps just to let everyone know how experienced is the crew that operates this particular ship.

2. Navigate and sail
Steering wheel comes along with a hovering camera for better sailing technique through narrow passes. Sailor also needs to take into account variation of the wind, angle of turning and the number of undamaged sails when engaging a pursuit of enemy or treasures. There's also a short boost bar under Shift key available which can come in handy in certain situations.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34061556/1e938c274a537b769840fae0a984f5d2c6bc3a82.png[/img]

3. Onboard duties
There are several things to do onboard to stay in game and win against other pirates. Checking horizon through windows and doors or using repairing bench to fix holes are some of them. And the most important:  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34061556/a73e793ee0d107c0e861d3e921a5b20b94458df5.png[/img]

4. Destroy
When the above mentioned activities succeed, the other ship will most likely sink just after losing speed because of the lack of sails. If it survives, the crew will have to use a repairing bench to fix the holes, but severely damaged parts won't be able to recover their full hitpoints. Sails and masts on the other hand, as more difficult to fix and cannot be replaced while sailing. We are working on an idea to let players fix them in docks, but the upcoming tests will prove if it's good for the gameplay.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34061556/2ae7edc0d56b6e99e00f965f6e0353c35de149ab.png[/img]

5. Summon
When your ship gets destroyed or your crew just left you behind, the old pirate ritual will be there to put you back in action. By the cost of permanent loss of 25% HP, everyone can ask a friendly kraken to fetch them a new vessel. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34061556/7c3687bd1dd9d65c657ecfe76c0c28d4342b51fb.png[/img]

Many thanks for sticking with us and reaching the end of this post! In the next one, we will show a bit more about inventory, weaponry and weapon attachments to be found on the islands. The next announcement is scheduled in 5 days.
